title: Global Scholars Program Scholarship (Clark University)
program_type: Merit-based university scholarship for international undergraduates (essay-required track)
duration: Not stated on the pages read; Clark awards international merit scholarships and need-based grants to first-year and transfer students
description: The Global Scholars Program Scholarship is Clark University's merit award for incoming international undergraduates who have shown leadership in their home communities, and the only international first-year merit scholarship besides the Presidential Scholarship that requires an extra essay rather than automatic consideration.

title: Invest Your Talent in Italy (IYT) — MAECI / ICE / Uni-Italia scholarship programme
official_source: Ministero degli Affari Esteri e della Cooperazione Internazionale (MAECI) — Directorate General for Growth and Export Promotion, with ICE and Uni-Italia
duration: 9 months of study, starting 1 October 2026 for the 2026-2027 academic year
description: Invest Your Talent in Italy is a MAECI scholarship programme run with the ICE Agency and Uni-Italia that pays a nine-month scholarship to foreign students from 22 partner countries to attend a Master's or Postgraduate course at a participating Italian university, combined with a compulsory internship at an Italian company or professional association. Courses are taught entirely in English, and the programme includes study of Italian language and culture plus a mandatory gender-equality and anti-gender-violence seminar or module. title: ARES Scholarships - Bourses de formations internationales (scholarships for study in Belgium)
program_type: Government scholarship of the Walloon government, administered by ARES
duration: Specialised bachelor's and specialised master's degrees: 12 months maximum (one academic year). Continuing training: 6 months maximum.

title: Boren Scholarships and Fellowships (National Security Education Program)
official_source: Defense Language and National Security Education Office (DLNSEO), National Security Education Program
program_type: Federal overseas study and research scholarship for U.S. students in national security critical regions
duration: Minimum 12 weeks (8 weeks for undergraduate STEM summer programmes); preference for programmes of at least 25 weeks; up to 52 weeks.
description: The National Security Education Program awards Boren Scholarships and Fellowships to U.S. undergraduate and graduate students committed to long-term overseas study and to federal service. Boren Scholarships fund study abroad by U.S. undergraduates and Boren Fellowships fund research and language study proposals by U.S. graduate students, in world regions critical to U.S. interests. title: Kyushu University Friendship Scholarship
degree: Undergraduate, Master's, PhD (exchange, special auditing, special research or double degree enrolment at Kyushu University)
program_type: University exchange scholarship (Kyushu University's own scheme)
duration: 3 months, 5 months (one semester) or 11 months (two semesters) at Kyushu University; the period of stay must begin within the academic year
description: Kyushu University's own support programme for privately financed international students who come to Kyushu University on exchange, special auditing, special research or double degree status and who cannot afford to study in Japan solely at their own expense. It pays a monthly stipend of JPY 80,000, and the total of all scholarships held by the grantee may not exceed that amount. Applicants apply through their prospective host department at Kyushu University, not directly to the university centre. title: Masters International Excellence Scholarships
description: The University of Leeds offers a set of merit scholarships worth £3,000, £6,000 or £16,000 to international students applying to eligible taught Master's courses starting in September 2027. The award is paid as a tuition fee discount on the first year of study only and cannot be used towards maintenance or accommodation costs. Applicants must already hold a conditional or unconditional offer and then submit a separate scholarship application; two rounds are scheduled for 28 February 2027 and 16 May 2027.

title: TU/e Scholarship for Excellence: Shaping the Future of Microchip Innovation
program_type: University merit scholarship (funded through the national Beethoven Programme)
description: Eindhoven University of Technology awards approximately 35 Scholarship for Excellence places to international students applying to selected Master's programmes in Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Mathematics & Computer Science for the 2027-2028 academic year. Each scholarship is worth €7,500 per academic year for two years, paid in monthly instalments, and the University states it is not a full scholarship. Consideration is part of the normal Master's application, which must be completed by 1 January 2027 with a short motivation.
